results.status: no new implementation defect found in reviewed scope
facts: Runtime route tests actually enforce reader and team boundaries, exercise concurrent close and injected audit rollback. These existing passed checks were inspected rather than rerun without changes.

The optional verified-query count query matches the included .sqlx JSON and filename SHA256; prior actual prepare/check/offline evidence exists in services-final-checks.log. This checks only that query against preparation schema, not all runtime SQL or deployed schema.
Lesson05-http explicitly distinguishes structured application errors from default framework extraction rejections. Fixture identities are explicitly not deployment authentication.

results.status: concrete defects fixed and verification gaps closed
facts: Completion now reads immutable payload from the locked durable row. Retry delay uses the stored attempts column instead of caller-modifiable Lease fields.
complete_with_clock samples after acquiring the row lock; binary uses now_ms callback. complete and fail with an integer now remain explicit logical-time APIs; live worker does not call fail.

Delayed-lock fixture observes PostgreSQL waiting before advancing its injected clock, then proves expired authority produces no effect. Validity is sampled under lock, not promised at physical commit completion.
Actual effect constraint failure leaves status running and no effect; after removal the valid lease can complete. Third abandoned attempt becomes dead.
HTTP router extracted without new dependencies; nine actual loopback cases test authentication/input/body rejections before database work.
Transactional outbox is taught as a pattern and extension; reference effect table is not falsely described as a delivered external relay.

results.status: read status defect fixed; UI retry concern handed to parent and corrected there
facts: inspect helper now distinguishes poisoned state503 from invalid history/cursor400; all four read routes verified after injected guard panic.
Existing boundary tests continue to pass for authorization, cancellation, history, lookup and joined worker shutdown.
Parent-owned replay UI/model retains exact ID/ticks after ambiguous outcomes. services.json now explains sticky uncertainty and open-page-only lifetime; see console-retry-review.html.
Capstone remains bounded, simulated, single-writer local journal; no production identity, arbitrary corruption recovery, PostgreSQL multi-account transaction or outbox relay claim was added.

Local wall clock rollback and distributed clock skew remain outside scheduler guarantees.
No browser interaction was performed; UI model/build evidence is separate.
One intermediate clock-refactor compile error (missing local now) was corrected; its raw log remains services-spec-clock-first-compile.log.
